messages:
sara_product: Pushing a compact RFC + PRD draft for the Redwood API changes we discussed this week. Focus areas: rerank API ergonomics, batched embeddings contract, and acceptance criteria for canary/rollout. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/api-rerank-embeddings-rfc :eyes:

kevin_engineering: skimmed it — big +1 on unifying the rerank response shape. One ask: callouts for backcompat when we add score metadata. We should include an example response with both old and new fields.

sara_product: good call. I added an "upgrade compatibility" section but it's terse. Suggest a matrix: client version -> supported fields -> fallback semantics.

devon_research: from QA of rerank models: we need clear guidance on whether ranks are stable with temperature changes and how to signal nondeterministic ties. Proposed field: `tie_breaker_hint` (nullable string).

miguel_pm: customer asks collected from two pilots: 1) ability to request deterministic sort (for billing/repro) 2) bulk embeddings with per-item metadata passthrough. Both impact API surface. We should decide scope for initial launch vs v2.

kevin_engineering: for deterministic sort we can add a query param `stable=true` which enforces seed=0 and deterministic post-processing. Cost: may block some runtime optimizations (KV cache ordering), but acceptable as opt-in. For bulk embeddings, we need to clarify per-item context size and streaming semantics.

sara_product: proposed launch scope: include `stable` flag and a minimal per-item metadata passthrough (opaque JSON attached to each input, returned verbatim). Defer advanced streaming/partial results to follow-up. Thoughts?

tina_support: customers will want a clear migration note. Add sample curl snippets and a table of error semantics (e.g., partial failures in bulk embeddings). Also include guidance for retries and idempotency keys.

kevin_engineering: added snippet to PRD. Quick config example we can publish in SDKs:

```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch
{
  "inputs": [
    {"text": "doc A", "meta": {"doc_id": "abc"}},
    {"text": "doc B", "meta": {"doc_id": "def"}}
  ],
  "options": {"model": "redwood-embed-compact", "dedupe": false}
}
```

Response will preserve `meta` fields per entry.

devon_research: acceptance criteria suggestion for rerank: (1) 99th p latency < 120ms for 256-token inputs under Dedicated perf tier; (2) deterministic mode replicates results across runs with same payload and seed; (3) automated eval harness demonstrates <=1% regression vs baseline on target prompts. Add CI gate for the harness.

sara_product: adding the latency numbers and CI harness requirement. For launch gating: require either Hosted or Dedicated SLOs met, docs + SDK examples, and at least one pilot account signed off.

miguel_pm: tradeoff note: if we ship per-item metadata passthrough we must ensure we do not echo user PII in logs. Add KMS/PII guidance and opt-out logging flag.

kevin_engineering: agreed — PRD updated with `log_redaction: true` default for RequestLogs and an opt-in `log_raw: true` for debugging (enterprise only). Also added README for ops about retaining minimal traces for billing.

tina_support: can we get a short FAQ section? common ask: "how to migrate from old rerank response" and "how to handle partial failures in embeddings batch". I'll draft and ping for review.

sara_product: perfect. Next steps: 1) eng to sign off on deterministic mode implementation by EOW, 2) research to add CI harness and baseline by next Wed, 3) support to draft migration FAQ and runbook. I'll incorporate comments and open PRD -> RFC thread for final review. :rocket:

ci-bot: automated check — PRD draft passes schema lint (docs-lint v2.1). Remaining: 4 unresolved comments in "compatibility matrix".

kevin_engineering: I'll take the compatibility comments. If nothing else blocks, we aim to ship an internal canary in two sprints and public beta after one more sprint.

sara_product: timeline recorded. Thanks all — please add brief +1 or objection inline by EOD tomorrow so we can cut the RFC.
